name: @hitslop/cli
description: Create, develop, build, register, and publish hitSlop apps.

scripts.build: bun ../../scripts/clean-dist.ts && bun build src/cli.ts src/module-loader.ts src/preview-authority.ts --target bun --format esm --packages external --outdir dist && /bin/chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.test: bun run --cwd ../schema build && bun run --cwd ../document-engine build && bun run --cwd ../api build && bun run --cwd ../runtime build && bun run --cwd ../svelte build && bun test
